[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bodyweight Lat Pulldowns: Pull arms down towards thighs while standing with arms extended overhead.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Resistance Band Bicep Curls: Use a resistance band or light dumbbell for bicep curls.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lateral Raises: Raise light dumbbells or water bottles out to the sides until at shoulder height.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Front Raises: Raise light dumbbells or water bottles forward and up until at shoulder height.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reverse Fly: Lift weights out to the sides with arms extended.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tricep Dips: Use a chair or bench to perform dips.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overhead Tricep Extensions: Hold a light dumbbell overhead and lower it behind the head.
